description: Non-SEO proof: generic scanner for any template+data pipeline. Detects common placeholder defaults that indicate a field was not parameterized. Usable by any scaffolder that uses {placeholder} substitution.

defaults.rationale: Unrendered str.format_map placeholder — the template variable was never substituted.
Explicit fill/missing marker left in output — indicates intentional gap that was never resolved.
Common placeholder/example values that may indicate template defaults leaked through.
